directed_by: custodian, 2026-08-10: adopt the C06 tombstone amendment and add the amendment-disposition rule. Stated motive: use good ideas from the model panel; more rounds are acceptable so long as the improvement is not lost.

convergence_measure.method: a DISCLOSED keyword test, re-runnable and refutable. NOT a judgement of similarity: three parties objected by name to the moderator judging two texts the same.

the_selection_was_the_workbenchs: Ten amendments were offered for C06 and ONE was adopted. Choosing among them is an act of the party the clause binds, and no convergence measure cures that. The custodian directed the adoption; the WORKBENCH selected which of the two tombstone variants, on the stated ground that it names what was removed, when AND why. The other tombstone variant is BALLOTED, not discarded.
what_adoption_is_not: ADOPTED is not RATIFIED. C06 remains NOT_RATIFIED: the amended text has never been put to the parties. Adoption changes what the workbench operates under, on the custodian's authority alone. Ratification is a later ballot, which this artifact unblocks.
